sn44.2:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn44.2:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anurādho bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharati.
sn44.2:1.3: atha kho sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāyasmā anurādho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anurādhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn44.2:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn44.2:1.5: yo so āvuso anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūtu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn44.2:1.6: hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vāti.
sn44.2:1.7: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn44.2:1.8: hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vāti.
sn44.2:1.9: evaṃ vutte te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn44.2:1.10: so cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo abyattoti.
sn44.2:1.11: atha kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn44.2:2.1: atha kho āyasmato anurādhassa acirapakkantesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi
sn44.2:2.2: sace kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn44.2:2.3: kathaṃ byākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyaṃ na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ gaccheyyāti.
sn44.2:2.4: atha kho āyasmā anurādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anurādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn44.2:2.5: idhāhaṃ bhante bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharāmi.
sn44.2:2.6: atha kho bhante sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā mayā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn44.2:2.7: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā maṃ etadavocuṃ
sn44.2:2.8: yo so āvuso anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn44.2:2.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vāti.
sn44.2:2.11: evaṃ vuttohaṃ bhante te aññatitthiye paribbājake etadavocaṃ
sn44.2:2.12: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatri mehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn44.2:2.14: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vāti.
sn44.2:2.15: evaṃ vutte bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā maṃ etadavocuṃ
sn44.2:2.16: so cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo abyattoti.
sn44.2:2.17: atha kho maṃ bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn44.2:2.18: tassa mayhaṃ bhante acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi
sn44.2:2.19: sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ puccheyyuṃ kathaṃ byākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyaṃ na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ gaccheyyāti.

sn44.2:7.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn44.2:7.2: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn44.2:11.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.

sn44.2:15.1: tasmā tiha anurādha yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn44.2:15.5: viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn44.2:15.6: evaṃ passaṃ anurādha sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃpi nibbindati vedanāyapi nibbindati saññāyapi nibbindati saṅkhāresupi nibbindati viññāṇasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn44.2:15.7: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn44.2:15.8: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn44.2:16.17: vedanāya tathāgatoti samanupassasīti. no hetaṃ bhante.
sn44.2:17.2: rūpaṃ vedanaṃ saññaṃ saṅkhāre viññāṇaṃ tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn44.2:17.5: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn44.2:17.7: ettha ca te anurādha diṭṭhe va dhamme saccato vā tathato vā anupalabbhiyamāno kallaṃ nu tetaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ
sn44.2:17.8: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatrimehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn44.2:17.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vāti.
sn44.2:17.13: pubbe cāhaṃ anurādha etarahi ca dukkhañceva paññapemi dukkhassa ca nirodhanti.
